programme.desc: Three brother bears awkwardly attempt to find their place in civilized society, whether they're looking for food, trying to make human friends, or scheming to become famous on the internet. Grizzly, Panda and Ice Bear stack atop one another when they leave their cave and explore the hipster environs of the San Francisco Bay Area, and it's clear the siblings have a lot to learn about a technologically driven world. By their side on many adventures are best friend Chloe (the only human character in the cast), fame-obsessed panda Nom Nom, and Charlie, aka Bigfoot. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy)

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: No, this animated series is not about anthropomorphic chewing gum, it's about a young cat named Gumball Watterson. Gumball has a penchant for getting into trouble, often resulting from schemes he comes up with, but he never seems to learn his lesson. Gumball's best friend is a fish named Darwin, who used to be the family pet until he grew legs and became part of the family. Gumball resents his younger sister, Anais, because she is the smartest member of the family. Gumball's mother is the breadwinner in the family, working long hours at the rainbow factory, and his father stays at home watching TV and playing video games. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.desc: S1E6 - Lance and Sonja cut through roof tiles to get to a killer beehive; Lance urges the homeowner to look at the hive, but she's petrified of bees; Lance finds a way to get her to face her fears. (Documentary)

programme.title: Sea Rescue - Help Is on the Way
programme.desc: S7E14 - When a lost white pelican lands on a California highway, a patrol officer becomes an unlikely hero; a sea turtle swims so far north that it becomes sick from the cold. (Animals, Science, Environment, Educational)

programme.title: Sea Rescue - Hidden in the Sand
programme.desc: S7E15 - A dog helps rescue a dying loggerhead sea turtle; a group of dedicated volunteers try to save African penguins from extinction. (Animals, Science, Environment, Educational)

programme.title: BlueMarvel - Baxter Autumn
programme.desc: S1E12 - A still evening as the life and light around Kidney Pond starts to go to bed; leaves begin their colorful transition, frogs and lily pads float, and Katahdin's ridgeline looms overhead. (Nature)

programme.title: Into The Amazon With Robson Green
programme.desc: S1E2 - Robson boards a traditional boat, his home for the next few days as he navigates the inky waters of the Rio Negro; his guide Saru gives him a tour of the boat before immersing him in the forest to learn some essential survival skills. (Travel)

programme.title: Amazon Unveiled - Echoes of the Andes
programme.desc: S1E1 - Explore the origins of the Amazon River in the Peruvian highlands, where ancient wisdom meets modern challenges in the fight to protect fragile ecosystems. (Nature, Documentary)

programme.title: Amazon Unveiled - Streams of Hope
programme.desc: S1E2 - Amidst the bustling city of Manaus, see how local heroes fight to restore polluted waterways and preserve the cultural heritage of Brazil's indigenous communities. - Jo Da Silva (Nature, Documentary)

programme.title: Forest School
programme.desc: Rain, shine, or snow, forest school is a go! Explore what happens when children are taught their schooling in the outdoors. Do kids thrive when they learn outside, or is it too much of a distraction? (Special, Nature, Documentary)

programme.title: Fireline
programme.desc: Firefighting teams struggle to save what they can while protecting each other during a California megafire, experiencing friendship, heartbreak and exhilaration as they battle an elemental force. (Documentary)

programme.title: Heart of the Osa
programme.desc: Explore the beauty and vital conservation efforts of Costa Rica's Osa Peninsula, one of the most biodiverse rainforests on the planet. (Special, Nature, Documentary)

programme.title: BlueMarvel - Dawn Pond of Brazil
programme.desc: S1E24 - Witness the event of dawn alongside a magical inland pond with birds, millipedes, and a range of plants; this is sunrise in the state of Rio Grande do Norte in northeastern Brazil. (Nature)

programme.title: The Wild Canadian Year - Making the Wild Canadian Year
programme.desc: S1E5 - A behind-the-scenes look at the endurance and technical skills that went into the making of "The Wild Canadian Year." (Documentary, Nature, Miniseries)

programme.title: Wild Winter - Adaptation

programme.title: Natural Disasters: Mega Regulators

programme.title: The World's Deadliest Weather - Marshall Fire

programme.title: Wastewater: A Tale of Two Cities

programme.title: EarthX Reels

Joining forces with Tim's secret-agent daughter, they must go undercover to prevent an evil genius from turning fellow toddlers into monstrous brats. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy)

Leaving the familiar confines of Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob and Patrick venture out towards Shell City, where they hope to find Neptune's crown, but numerous obstacles stand (or float) in their way. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: V for Vendetta
programme.desc: After world war leads to a fascist government, a vigilante known as V (Hugo Weaving) uses terrorist tactics to fight the totalitarian state in which he now lives. - Natalie Portman, Hugo Weaving, Stephen Rea (Movies, Action)

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Former Special Forces agent John Rambo blasts through Soviet-occupied Afghanistan in search of his captive mentor. - Sylvester Stallone, Richard Crenna, Marc de Jonge (Movies, Action)

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: A troubled Gulf War veteran (Denzel Washington) becomes suspicious after a powerful senator's (Meryl Streep) son (Liev Schreiber) becomes a candidate for vice president. - Denzel Washington, Meryl Streep, Liev Schreiber (Movies, Thriller)

programme.title: Hard Eight
programme.desc: A stranger (Philip Baker Hall) mentors a young Reno gambler (John C. Reilly) who weds a hooker (Gwyneth Paltrow) and befriends a vulgar casino regular. - Philip Baker Hall, John C. Reilly, Gwyneth Paltrow (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Globe-trotting archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis for possession of a legendary religious artifact. - Harrison Ford, Karen Allen, Paul Freeman (Movies, Adventure)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe. - Harrison Ford, Kate Capshaw, Ke Huy Quan (Movies, Adventure)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail. - Harrison Ford, Sean Connery, Denholm Elliott (Movies, Adventure)

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: Indy (Harrison Ford) and a young adventurer (Shia La Beouf) must ferret out a powerful artifact and keep it out of the hands of a deadly Soviet agent (Cate Blanchett). - Harrison Ford, Cate Blanchett, Shia LaBeouf (Movies, Adventure)

programme.title: Twister
programme.desc: Storm-chasers (Helen Hunt, Bill Paxton) finalizing their divorce try to place equipment inside a tornado on the Oklahoma plains. - Helen Hunt, Bill Paxton, Cary Elwes (Movies, Action)

programme.title: Reindeer Games
programme.desc: An ex-convict (Ben Affleck) wants to start a new life with his girlfriend (Charlize Theron), but her brother (Gary Sinise) involves him in a scheme to rob a casino. - Ben Affleck, Gary Sinise, Charlize Theron (Movies, Crime Story)

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: During the Iran hostage crisis, an extraction specialist (Ben Affleck) in the CIA poses as a Hollywood film producer to rescue six Americans who eluded Iranian militants and found refuge with the Canadian ambassador. - Ben Affleck, Bryan Cranston, Alan Arkin (Movies, History)

programme.title: Dexter: Resurrection
programme.desc: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. - Michael C. Hall, Jack Alcott, James Remar (Drama)

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat. - Tom Hanks, Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore (Movies, War)

programme.title: Bad Santa 2
programme.desc: Fueled by cheap whiskey and greed, a foulmouthed criminal (Billy Bob Thornton), his mean mother (Kathy Bates) and their angry sidekick (Tony Cox) conspire to bilk a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve. - Billy Bob Thornton, Kathy Bates, Tony Cox (Movies, Holidays, Comedy)

programme.title: Grizzly Night
programme.desc: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks. - Charles Esten, Oded Fehr, Brec Bassinger (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as the Coast Guard launches a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them. - Zachary Levi, Josh Duhamel, Quentin Plair (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: God chooses Noah (Russell Crowe) to build an ark and save the animals and his family from an apocalyptic flood. - Russell Crowe, Jennifer Connelly, Emma Watson (Movies, History)

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Dissatisfied with retirement, a 70-year-old widower becomes an intern at an online fashion site and develops a special bond with his young boss. - Robert De Niro, Anne Hathaway, Rene Russo (Movies, Comedy Drama)

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy. - Brad Pitt, Eric Bana, Orlando Bloom (Movies, Adventure)

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: A lieutenant colonel and approximately 400 U.S. troops battle 2,000 North Vietnamese soldiers in 1965. - Mel Gibson, Madeleine Stowe, Greg Kinnear (Movies, War)

programme.title: Apocalypse Now Redux
programme.desc: An Army agent (Martin Sheen) goes upriver into the heart of Cambodia to kill a renegade colonel (Marlon Brando). - Marlon Brando, Robert Duvall, Martin Sheen (Movies, War)

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: Crime boss Vito Corleone and his sons, the ruthless yet loyal members of the Corleone family, rule their secretive New York empire with an iron fist. - Marlon Brando, Al Pacino, James Caan (Movies, Crime Story)

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) rules his father's criminal empire, while flashbacks recall young Vito's (Robert De Niro) climb to power. - Al Pacino, Robert Duvall, Diane Keaton (Movies, Crime Story)

programme.title: The Godfather, Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Dignified Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) joins his wild nephew in a Sicilian vendetta involving the Vatican. - Al Pacino, Diane Keaton, Talia Shire (Movies, Crime Story)

programme.title: Beautiful Girls
programme.desc: The opposite sex preoccupies working-class pals gathered for their high-school reunion in small-town Massachusetts. - Timothy Hutton, Matt Dillon, Noah Emmerich (Movies, Comedy)

programme.title: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: After sex enters the equation, two lifelong friends (Natalie Portman, Ashton Kutcher) make a pact to keep their relationship purely physical. - Natalie Portman, Ashton Kutcher, Cary Elwes (Movies, Romance)

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: The world needed a hero and it got a hedgehog. Powered with incredible speed, Sonic races across the globe to stop uncool evil genius Dr. Robotnik from achieving world domination. - James Marsden, Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz (Movies, Family)

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: The destruction of their shuttle leaves two astronauts, Dr. Ryan Stone and Matt Kowalski, stranded in space with no hope of rescue. - Sandra Bullock, George Clooney, Ed Harris (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: Two cyborgs from the future battle over the life of a teen (Edward Furlong) who will someday lead humanity against the machines. - Arnold Schwarzenegger, Linda Hamilton, Edward Furlong (Movies, Sci-Fi)

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: Seasoned warrior Sarah Connor joins forces with a hybrid cyborg human and the T-800 model to protect a young woman from the Rev-9 -- a newly modified and seemingly indestructible liquid Terminator from the future. - Linda Hamilton, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Mackenzie Davis (Movies, Sci-Fi)

programme.title: Quantum of Solace
programme.desc: James Bond's (Daniel Craig) hunt for those responsible for Vesper Lynd's death leads him to a ruthless businessman (Mathieu Amalric) who is plotting to seize control of a valuable resource. - Daniel Craig, Olga Kurylenko, Mathieu Amalric (Movies, Action)

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: An IRA terrorist vows revenge against the ex-CIA agent who killed the man's brother and thwarted an attack on royalty. - Harrison Ford, Anne Archer, Patrick Bergin (Movies, Thriller)

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: Germany advances into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops are slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every vessel that can be found. - Fionn Whitehead, Tom Glynn-Carney, Jack Lowden (Movies, War)

programme.title: Cold Mountain
programme.desc: During the Civil War, a wounded Confederate soldier (Jude Law) abandons his duties to make his way home to his sweetheart (Nicole Kidman). - Jude Law, Nicole Kidman, Renée Zellweger (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: Homestead
programme.desc: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos. - Bailey Chase, Neal McDonough, Dawn Olivieri (Movies, Drama)

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: A slain Manhattan yuppie (Patrick Swayze) reaches out to his lover (Demi Moore), with a medium (Whoopi Goldberg) as his middle woman. - Patrick Swayze, Demi Moore, Whoopi Goldberg (Movies, Fantasy)

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: A treasure hunter (Matthew McConaughey) and his sidekick (Steve Zahn) join forces with a doctor (Penélope Cruz) to search for a Confederate ship in Africa. - Matthew McConaughey, Steve Zahn, Penélope Cruz (Movies, Adventure)

programme.title: Up in the Air

But his popularity declines sharply when his cheerleader girlfriend, Taylor (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe), leaves him for sleazy reality-television star Brock Hudson (Matthew Lillard). Desperate to revive his fading reputation, Siler agrees to a seemingly impossible challenge. He has six weeks to gain the trust of nerdy outcast Laney Boggs (Rachael Leigh Cook) -- and help her to become the school's next prom queen. - Freddie Prinze Jr., Rachael Leigh Cook, Matthew Lillard, Paul Walker, Jodi Lyn O'Keefe (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Jersey Girl
programme.desc: Ollie Trinke is young and at the top of his game as a music promoter. He is both a workaholic and a silver-tongued expert at manipulating the press. At a company Christmas party, Ollie meets Gertrude Steiney, a book editor for a New York publishing house. They are instantly attracted to each other, and begin a whirlwind romance that changes the course of his personal and professional life. - Ben Affleck, Liv Tyler, George Carlin, Jason Biggs, Raquel Castro (Romantic comedy, Comedy drama)

programme.title: Regarding Henry
programme.desc: An unscrupulous corporate lawyer, Henry Turner (Harrison Ford) will do whatever it takes to win a case, and treats his family with the same degree of ruthlessness. After Henry gets caught in the middle of a robbery and is shot in the head, he wakes from a coma to find that he has amnesia and can't even remember how to do the simplest of tasks. As he recovers and relearns how to function, Henry reveals a much kinder and more thoughtful personality, much to the surprise of his family and friends. - Harrison Ford, Annette Bening, Bill Nunn, Mikki Allen, Donald Moffat (Drama)

programme.title: The First Wives Club
programme.desc: Despondent over the marriage of her ex-husband to a younger woman, a middle-aged divorcée plunges to her death from her penthouse. At the woman's funeral, her former college friends (Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, Diane Keaton) reunite for the first time in nearly 30 years. When the three discover the reason for their friend's suicide, they realize that all of their ex-husbands have taken them for granted -- and deciding it's time for revenge, they make a pact to get back at their exes. - Goldie Hawn, Bette Midler, Diane Keaton, Maggie Smith, Sarah Jessica Parker (Comedy)

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: A chameleon who has lived as a sheltered family pet finds himself in the grip of an identity crisis. Rango wonders how to stand out when it is his nature to blend in. When he accidentally winds up in a frontier town called Dirt, he takes the first step on a transformational journey as the town's new sheriff. Though at first Rango only role-plays, a series of thrilling situations and outrageous encounters forces him to become a real hero. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Capt. James Kirk (William Shatner) and the crew of the USS Enterprise are carrying Klingon Chancellor Gorkon (David Warner) to Earth to negotiate a peace treaty with the United Federation of Planets. The ship appears to fire on a Klingon vessel, and Gorkon is killed in the subsequent confusion. Kirk and the ship's doctor, Leonard McCoy (DeForest Kelley), are arrested for murder, leaving Spock (Leonard Nimoy) to figure out who is behind the attack and save the negotiations. - William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, Walter Koenig (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Crime drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: This animated comedy finds Tommy Pickles (E.G. Daily) trying to return his baby brother to the hospital after being warned by his mean-spirited friend, Angelica (Cheryl Chase), that once his new sibling is born his parents won't care about him. But, soon after they embark on the mission, Tommy and his friends lose their way in the woods and get into trouble with a pack of wild monkeys who have escaped from the circus. The kids begin to think that maybe things weren't so bad at home after all. - E.G. Daily (Animated, Children, Adventure)

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Perpetual adversaries SpongeBob and Plankton join forces and come ashore to battle a pirate who has plans for the stolen Krabby Patties recipe. - Antonio Banderas, Slash, Christopher Backus (Children, Comedy, Adventure, Animated)

programme.title: Hotel for Dogs
programme.desc: After moving into a foster home that forbids pets, siblings Andi and Bruce must quickly find a home for their dog, Friday. The resourceful pair finds an abandoned hotel, and with the help of Bruce's mechanical skills, turn it into a pooch paradise for Friday and a number of strays. But when the inevitable barking makes neighbors suspicious, Andi and Bruce must find a way to hide their canine haven from prying eyes. - Emma Roberts, Jake T. Austin, Lisa Kudrow, Kevin Dillon, Don Cheadle (Children, Comedy, Drama, Adventure)

programme.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
programme.desc: A collection of short films showcasing different themes. (Anthology)

programme.title: Harriet the Spy
programme.desc: Harriet (Michelle Trachtenberg) may only be in the sixth grade, but she's already found her calling: to be a spy. In a private journal she takes everywhere, Harriet records suspicious activity and keeps a running list of observations on virtually everyone she knows. It seems harmless enough until, one day, someone finds the journal and exposes Harriet's critical thoughts about her classmates. Suddenly, even her best friends are against her, and Harriet resolves to take revenge. - Michelle Trachtenberg, Rosie O'Donnell, Vanessa Lee Chester, Gregory Smith, J. Smith-Cameron (Children, Comedy drama)

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins. - Juliette Binoche, Johnny Depp, Lena Olin, Judi Dench, Alfred Molina (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Don Jon
programme.desc: New Jersey bartender Jon Martello knows what's important: his friends, his family, his car, his church, his sexual conquests -- and porn. In fact, Jon is a porn addict and has never had a genuine relationship with a woman. However, when he meets Barbara he has to change his operating methods, because Barbara won't be bedded easily. For the first time in his life, Jon begins a real courtship, but his obsession with erotica threatens to ruin everything. - Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Scarlett Johansson, Julianne Moore, Tony Danza, Glenne Headley (Comedy drama, Romance)

programme.title: Vicious
programme.desc: Polly receives a mysterious box that comes with instructions to place three things inside: something you need, something you hate, and something you love. What begins as a strange ritual quickly unravels into a waking nightmare as she becomes trapped in a terrifying world where reality bends and memory betrays. As time slips away, she must confront the darkness not just around her, but within her, before it consumes everything and everyone she's ever known. - Dakota Fanning, Kathryn Hunter, Mary McCormack, Rachel Blanchard, Devyn Nekoda (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Stop-Loss

Unexpectedly, the Army invokes a clause in Brandon's military contract, requiring him to return to active duty in Iraq. With the help of close friend Michele, Brandon goes AWOL and struggles to find a way out of the dilemma. - Ryan Phillippe, Abbie Cornish, Channing Tatum, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Ciarán Hinds (Drama, War)

His brand-new stepmother, Beverly (Bo Derek), wants to cash out and close, but Tommy's sentimental attachment to his father's employees spurs him to make one last-ditch effort to find someone who will buy their products. With his father's tightly wound assistant, Richard (David Spade), in tow, Tommy hits the road to scare up some new clients. - Chris Farley, David Spade, Brian Dennehy, Bo Derek, Dan Aykroyd (Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Hotel for Dogs
programme.desc: After moving into a foster home that forbids pets, siblings Andi and Bruce must quickly find a home for their dog, Friday. Austin, Lisa Kudrow, Kevin Dillon, Don Cheadle (Children, Comedy, Drama, Adventure)

programme.title: War Pony

programme.title: Passion Play: Russell Westbrook
programme.desc: Rare footage and extensive interviews provide insight into the dynamic life and career of NBA player Russell Westbrook. (Special, Documentary, Biography, Basketball)

Based on a true story. - Miles Teller, Aaron Eckhart, Katey Sagal, Ciarán Hinds, Ted Levine (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Indebted to a big-time drug lord, a pot dealer travels to Mexico with a fake family and a camper to pick up a large shipment and smuggle it into the U.S.

programme.title: Doin' It

programme.title: Rebel in the Rye

programme.title: Winter Spring Summer or Fall

programme.title: Certain Women

programme.title: Safe Haven
programme.desc: Dark secrets intrude on the blossoming romance between a widowed merchant and a new arrival in a small North Carolina town.

programme.title: Marvelous and the Black Hole
programme.desc: A rebellious 13-year-old who is dealing with the loss of her mother embarks on an adventure with a children's party magician.

programme.title: A Wonderful Time of the Year
programme.desc: The Marsh family's getting together for their first Christmas Eve after three years of pandemic lockdown.

programme.title: Horrible Bosses
programme.desc: Three oppressed workers (Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis) devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to rid themselves of their intolerable employers.

programme.title: Dear Santa

programme.title: Daniela Forever
programme.desc: After his girlfriend dies in an accident, a grieving man joins a sleep trial that allows him to rebuild his life with her through the use of lucid dreams.

programme.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker

programme.title: Safe Haven
programme.desc: Katie Feldman moves to a small town on the North Carolina coast, determined to make a new life for herself. She takes a job as a waitress and keeps a low profile, but she is soon won over by the warmth and caring of the close-knit community, especially that of Alex, a widower. programme.title: Fight or Flight
programme.desc: A mercenary takes on the job of tracking a high-value asset known only as "The Ghost" on an international flight. Realizing the plane is filled with assassins assigned to kill them both, the pair must work together in a fight for their lives. - Josh Hartnett, Charithra Chandran, Marko Zaror, Katee Sackhoff, Julian Kostov (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Crawlspace
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. - Henry Thomas, Bradley Stryker, Jennifer Robertson, Olivia Taylor Dudley, C. Ernst Harth (Thriller)

programme.title: He's Just Not That Into You
programme.desc: Baltimore-based friends and lovers, all in their 20s and 30s, try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships. Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. programme.title: A.C.O.D.
programme.desc: An attempt to negotiate a truce between his bitterly divorced parents sends a man (Adam Scott) back to his childhood therapist, where he learns he was the subject of her self-help book. - Adam Scott, Richard Jenkins, Catherine O'Hara, Amy Poehler, Mary Elizabeth Winstead (Comedy)

programme.title: Outside Providence

The one saving grace of the new school is Jane (Amy Smart), a fellow student Tim falls for immediately. - Shawn Hatosy, Jon Abrahams, Tommy Bone, Jonathan Brandis, Jack Ferver (Comedy drama)

While the adults come up with a dodgy scheme, the friends try a more practical approach to the problem with the help of Helga (Francesca Marie Smith). The kids discover their neighborhood was designated as a historical landmark, but they must prove it before Scheck moves in with his crew. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: The Layover
programme.desc: Best friends Kate and Meg find themselves competing for the same man while waiting for their plane to take off from St. Louis. - Alexandra Daddario, Kate Upton, Matt Barr, Matt Jones, Molly Shannon (Comedy)

programme.title: The Cut
programme.desc: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul. - Orlando Bloom, Caitriona Balfe, John Turturro, Clare Dunne, Gary Beadle (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury

They exist only to hit on women at discos, though they're routinely unsuccessful until a chance run-in with Richard Grieco gets them inside the swank Roxbury club. Mistaken for high rollers, they meet their dream women, Vivica and Cambi, and resolve to open a club of their own. - Will Ferrell, Chris Kattan, Molly Shannon, Dan Hedaya, Loni Anderson (Comedy)

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: After discovering his girlfriend has been participating in group sex, attorney Mitch feels his world come undone. He moves into a new place, which happens to be near a college campus, and tries to get his life back together. Two of his best friends, Frank and Beanie, start hanging out at Mitch's house, eventually turning the place into a wild party pad, much to the ire of the college's dean, Gordon "Cheese" Pritchard. - Luke Wilson, Will Ferrell, Vince Vaughn, Jeremy Piven, Ellen Pompeo (Comedy)

programme.title: Magic Mike XXL
programme.desc: It's been three years since Mike Lane's (Channing Tatum) retirement from stripping, but the former dancer misses the excitement and feeling of being on stage. Most of all, though, he misses the best friends that he ever had, the crew known as the Kings of Tampa. Opportunity comes knocking when the guys look him up as they travel to Myrtle Beach, S.C., for a stripper convention. With the promise of outrageous fun, a reinvigorated Mike can't resist the chance to join in and take it off again. - Channing Tatum, Matt Bomer, Joe Manganiello, Kevin Nash, Adam Rodriguez (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Horrible Bosses 2

After demonstrating the prototype for an invention called the Shower Buddy, the guys attract the attention of Rex Hanson and his father, Bert. Bert invests in the trio's product, then cancels the order and steals their idea. Now heavily in debt and with no legal recourse, Nick, Dale and Kurt decide to kidnap Rex and use the ransom money to pay off their loans. - Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis, Jennifer Aniston, Kevin Spacey (Comedy)

programme.title: Bad Santa 2

Along for the ride is chubby and cheery Thurman Merman, a 250-pound ray of sunshine who brings out Willie's sliver of humanity. Mommy issues arise when the pair are joined by Willie's horror story of a mother, Sunny Soke, who raises the bar for the gang's ambitions, while somehow lowering the standards of criminal behavior. - Billy Bob Thornton, Kathy Bates, Tony Cox, Christina Hendricks, Brett Kelly (Holiday, Comedy)

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa 0.5
programme.desc: Irving Zisman takes his young and impressionable grandson on a cross-country trip in which they encounter male strippers, biker-bar patrons and other unsuspecting citizens. - Johnny Knoxville, Jackson Nicoll, Georgina Cates, Greg Harris, Spike Jonze (Comedy)

programme.title: Nobody's Fool
programme.desc: After serving five years in prison, wild child Tanya looks to her buttoned-up, by-the-book sister Danica to help her get back on her feet. The feisty ex-con becomes suspicious and concerned when Danica tells her that she's in a long-distance, online relationship with a mysterious man she's never seen. As the polar opposites start to collide, Tanya soon discovers that her sibling's picture-perfect life may not be what it seems. - Tiffany Haddish, Tika Sumpter, Omari Hardwick, Whoopi Goldberg, Amber Riley (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S. - Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin, Scott Glenn, Sam Neill, James Earl Jones (Thriller, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. - Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba, Michael Cera, Kevin Costner, Jeremy Strong (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: The implausible escape of a brilliant murderess brings U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels and his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like insane asylum located on a remote, windswept island. The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive. - Leonardo DiCaprio, Mark Ruffalo, Ben Kingsley, Max von Sydow, Michelle Williams (Thriller, Mystery, Drama)

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: The sweeping expanses of the Sahara are the setting for a passionate love affair in this adaptation of Michael Ondaatje's novel. A badly burned man, Laszlo de Almasy (Ralph Fiennes), is tended to by a nurse, Hana (Juliette Binoche), in an Italian monastery near the end of World War II. His past is revealed through flashbacks involving a married Englishwoman (Kristin Scott Thomas) and his work mapping the African landscape. Hana learns to heal her own scars as she helps the dying man. - Ralph Fiennes, Juliette Binoche, Willem Dafoe, Kristin Scott Thomas, Naveen Andrews (Romance, War, Historical drama)

programme.title: Edge of Tomorrow
programme.desc: When Earth falls under attack from invincible aliens, no military unit in the world is able to beat them. Maj. William Cage (Tom Cruise), an officer who has never seen combat, is assigned to a suicide mission. Killed within moments, Cage finds himself thrown into a time loop, in which he relives the same brutal fight -- and his death -- over and over again. However, Cage's fighting skills improve with each encore, bringing him and a comrade (Emily Blunt) ever closer to defeating the aliens. - Tom Cruise, Emily Blunt, Brendan Gleeson, Bill Paxton, Jonas Armstrong (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, must prevent the Man in Black (Matthew McConaughey) from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: Seasoned warrior Sarah Connor joins forces with a hybrid cyborg human and the T-800 model to protect a young woman from the Rev-9 -- a newly modified and seemingly indestructible liquid Terminator from the future.

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Xerxes, driven by vengeance for his father's death, leads an army against Greece; Greek city-states join forces under Athens' command to fight Artemisia in a naval battle.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 3
programme.desc: A videographer becomes obsessed with finding the source of disturbing late-night noises in his home and discovers its terrifying origin.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: Molly Bloom runs the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested by the FBI. Her only ally is defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learns that there is much more to Molly than the tabloids lead people to believe.

programme.title: House at the End of the Street
programme.desc: A divorcee (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter (Jennifer Lawrence) learn that they have moved next door to a house in which a girl killed her parents, then disappeared, leaving a brother (Max Thieriot) as the only survivor.

programme.title: Alone in Berlin
programme.desc: A German couple lose their son in WWII, prompting them to become secretly anti-Nazi.

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as the Coast Guard launches a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: For Lieutenant Pete "Maverick" Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick "Goose" Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot.

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Coerced into working for a crime boss, a talented getaway driver must face the music when a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: Magic Mike
programme.desc: A male stripper takes a newcomer under his wing and instructs him in the fine arts of partying, picking up women and making plenty of money.

programme.title: Just Go With It
programme.desc: A plastic surgeon (Adam Sandler) enlists the aid of his assistant (Jennifer Aniston) and her children to help him win the heart of a beautiful woman.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: The parents of a young man (Matthew McConaughey) who still lives at home hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to finally leave the nest.

programme.title: Morning Glory
programme.desc: Newly hired as a producer on a national morning-news program called "Daybreak," Becky Fuller (Rachel McAdams) decides to revitalize the low-rated show by bringing in legendary anchorman Mike Pomeroy (Harrison Ford). Pomeroy, however, refuses to do puff pieces like celebrity gossip and fashion, and clashes with his co-host (Diane Keaton). programme.title: Nine
programme.desc: Italian film director Guido Contini (Daniel Day-Lewis) grapples with epic crises in his personal and professional lives. At the same time, he must strike a balance of the demands of numerous women in his life, including his wife (Marion Cotillard), his mistress (Penélope Cruz), and his confidant (Judi Dench). - Daniel Day-Lewis, Marion Cotillard, Penélope Cruz, Judi Dench, Fergie (Musical, Romance)

programme.title: Fatal Attraction

But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. - Michael Douglas, Glenn Close, Anne Archer, Ellen Hamilton Latzen, Stuart Pankin (Thriller, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
programme.desc: Evil Judge Turpin (Alan Rickman) lusts for the beautiful wife of a London barber (Johnny Depp) and transports him to Australia for a crime he did not commit. Though many fall to his blade, he will not be satisfied until he slits Turpin's throat. - Johnny Depp, Helena Bonham Carter, Alan Rickman, Timothy Spall, Sacha Baron Cohen (Musical, Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them. - Zachary Levi, Josh Duhamel, Quentin Plair, Terrence Terrell, Marshall Cook (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Run & Gun
programme.desc: After leaving a life of crime and violence, reformed good guy Ray enjoys a quiet family life in the suburbs. However, Ray's past comes back to haunt him as he gets blackmailed into one last job to collect a mysterious package. After a deadly double-cross, he soon finds himself wounded and on the run from ruthless assassins who will stop at nothing to get what he has. - Ben Milliken, Brad William Henke, Janel Parrish, Mark Dacascos, Celestino Cornielle (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers. - Jackie Chan, Pierce Brosnan, Ray Fearon, Orla Brady, Tao Liu (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Reindeer Games
programme.desc: Just released from prison, all Rudy Duncan (Ben Affleck) wants is to start a new life with Ashley (Charlize Theron), the girl of his dreams, whom he met through pen pal letters in prison. But between them and happiness stands her crazy brother, Gabriel (Gary Sinise), and his motley crew of deadly criminals who think Rudy has some inside information about a casino where he once had a job -- a casino Gabriel and his short-fused posse plan to take down. - Ben Affleck, Gary Sinise, Charlize Theron, Dennis Farina, James Frain (Crime drama, Thriller, Action)

programme.title: Domestic Disturbance
programme.desc: Frank Morrison (John Travolta) no longer lives with his ex-wife, Susan (Teri Polo), and 12-year-old son, Danny (Matt O'Leary). Susan and Danny now live with Rick Barnes (Vince Vaughn), Susan's new husband. Danny, who has a reputation for telling lies, has accused his stepfather of committing a murder. But Frank is the only one who believes him. Now the father Danny trusts must protect him from the stepfather he fears. - John Travolta, Vince Vaughn, Teri Polo, Matt O'Leary, Ruben Santiago-Hudson (Thriller)

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a traveling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune. - Jim Cummings, Jocelin Donahue, Sierra McCormick, Nicholas Logan, Michael Abbott Jr. (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Homestead
programme.desc: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos. - Bailey Chase, Neal McDonough, Dawn Olivieri, Kearran Giovanni, Olivia Sanabia (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. - Michael Douglas, Glenn Close, Anne Archer, Ellen Hamilton Latzen, Stuart Pankin (Thriller, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own. - Matt Damon, Gwyneth Paltrow, Jude Law, Cate Blanchett, Philip Seymour Hoffman (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery, Romance)

programme.title: Queen of the Damned
programme.desc: Follows the legendary vampire Lestat (Stuart Townsend), who has reinvented himself as a rock star in the contemporary American music scene. His music wakes Akasha (Aaliyah), the queen of all vampires, and inspires her desire to make Lestat her king. Akasha's malevolent power is so great that all the immortal vampires must stand against her if they want to survive. Meanwhile, a young London woman with a fascination for the dark side (Marguerite Moreau) falls in love with Lestat. - Stuart Townsend, Aaliyah, Marguerite Moreau, Vincent Perez, Paul McGann (Horror)

programme.title: House at the End of the Street
programme.desc: In search of a fresh start, divorcee Sarah (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter, Elissa (Max Thieriot), find their dream house in a small town. But when startling, unexplainable events begin, the pair learn that a chilling secret holds the town in its grip. Years earlier a girl killed her parents and disappeared, leaving a brother, Ryan (Max Thieriot), as the sole survivor. Elissa begins a relationship with Ryan, and the closer they get, the deeper they're all pulled into a dangerous mystery. - Jennifer Lawrence, Max Thieriot, Elisabeth Shue, Gil Bellows, Eva Link (Thriller, Horror)

programme.title: The Firm
programme.desc: A young lawyer joins a small but prestigious law firm only to find out that most of their clients are on the wrong side of the law. The company is helping to launder mob money, get clients off charges and even murder partners who threaten to blow their cover, but when the FBI come calling to gather evidence on the lawyer's colleagues, he is caught between a rock and a hard place, juggling his life and his liberty. - Tom Cruise, Jeanne Tripplehorn, Gene Hackman, Holly Hunter, Ed Harris (Drama, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Rock of Ages
programme.desc: The songs of Journey, Bon Jovi, Def Leppard and other artists underscore a tale of big dreams in Hollywood. Soon after hopping off a bus from the Midwest, aspiring singer Sherrie Christian immediately finds herself in trouble. Coming to her rescue is Drew, a bar-back at the legendary club the Bourbon Room. With stars in their eyes, the young lovers chase their dreams, but a misunderstanding involving rock god Stacee Jaxx threatens to tear them apart. - Julianne Hough, Diego Boneta, Russell Brand, Paul Giamatti, Catherine Zeta-Jones (Musical)

programme.title: Beautiful Girls
programme.desc: An all-star cast sparks this captivating comedy about a group of old friends whose 10-year high school reunion creates some hilariously unexpected surprises. Willie (Timothy Hutton), Tommy (Matt Dillon), and Paul may have lost a bit of their youth, but they're still ready to party with Uma Thurman, Rosie O'Donnell, Lauren Holly, and Mira Sorvino -- the beautiful girls who've turned their lives upside down! - Timothy Hutton, Matt Dillon, Noah Emmerich, Annabeth Gish, Lauren Holly (Drama, Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Regarding Henry
programme.desc: An unscrupulous corporate lawyer, Henry Turner (Harrison Ford) will do whatever it takes to win a case, and treats his family with the same degree of ruthlessness. After Henry gets caught in the middle of a robbery and is shot in the head, he wakes from a coma to find that he has amnesia and can't even remember how to do the simplest of tasks. As he recovers and relearns how to function, Henry reveals a much kinder and more thoughtful personality, much to the surprise of his family and friends. - Harrison Ford, Annette Bening, Bill Nunn, Mikki Allen, Donald Moffat (Drama)

programme.title: Jersey Girl
programme.desc: Ollie Trinke is young and at the top of his game as a music promoter. He is both a workaholic and a silver-tongued expert at manipulating the press. At a company Christmas party, Ollie meets Gertrude Steiney, a book editor for a New York publishing house. They are instantly attracted to each other, and begin a whirlwind romance that changes the course of his personal and professional life. - Ben Affleck, Liv Tyler, George Carlin, Jason Biggs, Raquel Castro (Romantic comedy, Comedy drama)

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: After enduring setbacks in her television career, executive Joanna Eberhart (Nicole Kidman) relocates with her family from New York City to the Connecticut suburb of Stepford. While Joanna's husband, Walter (Matthew Broderick), quickly warms up to their new town, she has a hard time adjusting to Stepford's manicured environs and the overly accommodating attitude of the area women. Soon Joanna begins to suspect that something is not right, and she tries to uncover Stepford's secret. - Nicole Kidman, Matthew Broderick, Bette Midler, Glenn Close, Christopher Walken (Dark comedy, Horror, Thriller, Science fiction)

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: Pressured into taking his overbearing mother along for the ride, a man embarks on the road trip of a lifetime.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Dissatisfied with retirement, a 70-year-old widower becomes an intern at an online fashion site and develops a special bond with his young boss.

programme.title: Everybody's Fine
programme.desc: A widower (Robert De Niro) sets out on a road trip to reconnect with each of his adult children, then he finds that their lives are far from perfect.

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: As if creating the perfect Christmas for their families isn't hard enough, under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla will have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers during the holidays.

programme.title: Happy Christmas
programme.desc: An immature party girl (Anna Kendrick) moves in with her brother's family to get over a breakup and throws their lives out of whack.

programme.title: I Used to Go Here
programme.desc: A successful author finds herself deeply enmeshed in the lives of a group of college students after being asked to speak at her alma mater.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: An attractive lawyer and Bridget's (Renée Zellweger) former boss (Hugh Grant) threaten her newfound happiness with Mark Darcy (Colin Firth).

programme.title: Three Wishes
programme.desc: A frustrated family man recalls an encounter he (Joseph Mazzello), his widowed mom (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio) and his family had with a mysterious vagrant (Patrick Swayze) in 1955 suburbia.

programme.title: Love, Rosie
programme.desc: Rosie and Alex are best friends until Alex's family moves to America. They gamble everything to keep their love and friendship alive over the years and miles.

programme.title: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: After sex enters the equation, two lifelong friends (Natalie Portman, Ashton Kutcher) make a pact to keep their relationship purely physical.

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Old wounds get a chance to heal when a Wyoming rancher (Robert Redford) shelters his abused daughter-in-law (Jennifer Lopez) and her child.

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: A man (John Cusack) and a woman (Kate Beckinsale) try to find each other after spending one night together 10 years earlier.

programme.title: An Officer and a Gentleman
programme.desc: A hardened loner (Richard Gere) shapes up for a military drill instructor (Louis Gossett Jr.) and a factory girl (Debra Winger) from town.

programme.title: Urban Cowboy
programme.desc: A Texas farmer (John Travolta) moves to the city, immerses himself in honky-tonk and falls for a sexy cowgirl (Debra Winger).

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: A wedding singer loses all hope when he is abandoned at the altar by his fiancée. He meets a young woman named Julia, who enlists his help to plan her wedding. He falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: Moving in from Chicago, newcomer Ren McCormack (Kevin Bacon) is in shock when he discovers the small Midwestern town he now calls home has made dancing and rock music illegal. As he struggles to fit in, Ren faces an uphill battle to change things. With the help of his new friend, Willard Hewitt (Christopher Penn), and defiant teen Ariel Moore (Lori Singer), he might loosen up this conservative town. But Ariel's influential father, Reverend Shaw Moore (John Lithgow), stands in the way. - Kevin Bacon, Lori Singer, John Lithgow, Dianne Wiest, Christopher Penn (Drama, Music, Romance, Comedy)

programme.title: Don Jon
programme.desc: New Jersey bartender Jon Martello knows what's important: his friends, his family, his car, his church, his sexual conquests -- and porn. In fact, Jon is a porn addict and has never had a genuine relationship with a woman. However, when he meets Barbara he has to change his operating methods, because Barbara won't be bedded easily. For the first time in his life, Jon begins a real courtship, but his obsession with erotica threatens to ruin everything. - Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Scarlett Johansson, Julianne Moore, Tony Danza, Glenne Headley (Comedy drama, Romance)

programme.title: Blue Valentine
programme.desc: Dean (Ryan Gosling) and Cindy (Michelle Williams) live a quiet life in a modest neighborhood. To the casual observer, everything appears normal, if a bit subdued. But a closer examination reveals a couple caught in a downward spiral. They appear to have the world at their feet at the outset of the relationship. However, his lack of ambition and her retreat into self-absorption cause potentially irreversible cracks in their marriage. - Ryan Gosling, Michelle Williams, Faith Wladyka, John Doman, Mike Vogel (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Tom Cruise and Cameron Crowe reunite after "Jerry Maguire" for "Vanilla Sky," the story of a young New York City publishing magnate who finds himself on an unexpected roller-coaster ride of romance, comedy, suspicion, love, sex and dreams in a mind-bending search for his soul. - Tom Cruise, Penélope Cruz, Cameron Diaz, Kurt Russell, Jason Lee (Thriller, Drama, Romance, Science fiction, Mystery)

programme.title: Proof
programme.desc: Catherine (Gwyneth Paltrow) is a 27-year-old grieving after the loss of her father (Anthony Hopkins), a genius mathematician whose mind gradually deteriorated from mental illness. With her sister, Claire (Hope Davis), urging Catherine to leave their family home, and an ambitious student (Jake Gyllenhaal) searching through her father's notes, Catherine struggles to keep her composure and her sanity in this drama adapted from the stage play by David Auburn. - Gwyneth Paltrow, Anthony Hopkins, Jake Gyllenhaal, Hope Davis, Gary Houston (Drama)

programme.title: Red Eye
programme.desc: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father. - Rachel McAdams, Cillian Murphy, Brian Cox, Jayma Mays, Jack Scalia (Thriller, Action, Drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. - Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba, Michael Cera, Kevin Costner, Jeremy Strong (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: Twisted
programme.desc: Kara and Tyler are planning on getting married when Tyler's ex-girlfriend returns from rehab, determined to get her life back - starting with Tyler. - Elisabeth Harnois, Morgan Kelly, Kimberly-Sue Murray, Thomas Mitchell, Victoria Sanchez (Thriller)

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished; trying to help some teens, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now, David's in big debt to his supplier and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang. - Jennifer Aniston, Jason Sudeikis, Will Poulter, Emma Roberts, Ed Helms (Comedy, Action, Crime drama)

programme.title: Queen Bees
programme.desc: While her house undergoes repairs, fiercely independent senior Helen temporarily moves into a nearby retirement community, where she encounters lusty widows, cutthroat bridge tournaments and a hotbed of bullying "mean girls." - Ellen Burstyn, James Caan, Ann-Margret, Jane Curtin, Loretta Devine (Comedy)

programme.desc: On a remote coastal island, a former assassin living in self-imposed exile rescues a young girl from a deadly storm. As their lives start to intertwine, he must protect the orphan while battling enemies from his past. - Jason Statham, Bodhi Rae Breathnach, Bill Nighy, Naomi Ackie, Daniel Mays (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Michael
programme.desc: The story of pop superstar Michael Jackson, from his extraordinary early days in the Jackson 5 to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuels a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world. - Jaafar Jackson, Colman Domingo, Nia Long, Juliano Valdi, KeiLyn Durrel Jones (Biography, Drama, Music, Pop, Soul)

programme.title: Why Men Are Clueless
programme.desc: Omar Baker is a writer who is struggling in both his professional life and his relationship. Omar and his three friends tries to figure out what makes women tick. - Danny Wooten, Derrex Brady, Marcuis Harris, Christina Webber, Carmen Serano (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: The Devil You Know
programme.desc: Ex-con Marcus Cowans is trying to turn over a new leaf with the support of his loving family. After learning that one of his brothers may have been involved in a horrific crime, Marcus grapples with the limits of loyalty. He and his family, increasingly weary of the justice system's failings, soon end up in the crosshairs of a seasoned but jaded detective. - Omar Epps, Michael Ealy, Will Catlett, Glynn Turman, Curtiss Cook (Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: On a magical night when they are in their 20s, Jonathan (John Cusack) meets Sara (Kate Beckinsale). He finds it love at first sight, but Sara believes in destiny. After 10 years the two -- with 3,000 miles between them -- must decide if fate wants them to be together again. When love feels like magic, it is called destiny; when destiny has a sense of humor, it is serendipity. - John Cusack, Kate Beckinsale, Molly Shannon, Jeremy Piven, John Corbett (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: I Can Only Imagine 2
programme.desc: After the breakout success of the song "I Can Only Imagine," MercyMe's Bart Millard is living the dream with sold-out arenas, a devoted fan base, and a thriving career. However, Millard's past soon threatens the family he's built, especially the fragile bond with his son, Sam. - John Michael Finley, Milo Ventimiglia, Dennis Quaid, Trace Adkins, Sophie Skelton (Drama, Music)

programme.title: Leap Year
programme.desc: When yet another anniversary passes without a marriage proposal from her boyfriend, Anna (Amy Adams) decides to take action. Aware of a Celtic tradition that allows women to pop the question on Feb. 29, she plans to follow her lover to Dublin and ask him to marry her. Fate has other plans, however, and Anna winds up on the other side of the Emerald Isle with handsome, but surly, Declan -- an Irishman who may just lead Anna down the road to true love. - Amy Adams, Matthew Goode, Adam Scott, John Lithgow, Noel O'Donovan (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Michael
programme.desc: The story of pop superstar Michael Jackson, from his extraordinary early days in the Jackson 5 to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuels a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world. - Jaafar Jackson, Colman Domingo, Nia Long, Juliano Valdi, KeiLyn Durrel Jones (Biography, Drama, Music, Pop, Soul)

programme.title: The Serpent Queen - Grand Tour
programme.desc: S2E1 - Catherine aims to unite France under King Charles IX, pushing her agenda of a secular state; the Bourbons present an ambitious trade deal with Protestant England; as tensions rise on the Privy Council, the Guise's plan to reignite religious conflict. - Samantha Morton, Charles Dance, Amrita Acharia, Colm Meaney, Barry Atsma (Drama)

programme.title: The Serpent Queen - Second Coming
programme.desc: S2E2 - With peace lying on a knife's edge, Catherine attempts to calm tensions by allowing the Bourbons to pursue the trade deal with England, and she halts the investigation into the Duke of Guise's arson involvement. - Samantha Morton, Charles Dance, Amrita Acharia, Colm Meaney, Barry Atsma (Drama)

programme.title: The Break-Up
programme.desc: When Brooke (Jennifer Aniston), an art dealer, and Gary (Vince Vaughn), a tour-bus driver, finally call it quits in their relationship, neither is willing to move out of their shared condo. With their friends suggesting a series of underhanded tactics that fail to get either Brooke or Gary to cave in, the only solution is to become hostile roommates. - Vince Vaughn, Jennifer Aniston, Joey Lauren Adams, Cole Hauser, Jon Favreau (Romantic comedy, Drama)

Veteran cop Richie Roberts senses a change in the mob's power structure and looks for ways to bring his opponent to justice. - Denzel Washington, Russell Crowe, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Cuba Gooding Jr., Josh Brolin (Crime drama, Biography)

programme.title: Beast
programme.desc: After years away from the cage, a once-feared MMA champion is pulled back in for the fight of his life when his younger brother is put in danger. Reuniting with the trainer who once made him a legend, he commits to one final showdown against the reigning title-holder: a brutal fighter determined to dismantle the ex-champ's legacy in front of the world. Pushed to his breaking point, the contender's stakes are simple: win, or lose everything he's built. - Daniel MacPherson, Russell Crowe, Luke Hemsworth, Mojean Aria, Nathan Phillips (Action, Drama)

programme.title: Replicas
programme.desc: Neuroscientist William Foster is on the verge of transferring human consciousness into a computer when his beloved wife and children are killed in a car crash. Desperate to resurrect his family, Foster recruits a fellow scientist to secretly help clone their bodies and create replicas. When William learns that he can only replicate three of his four family members, he makes a decision that holds fateful consequences. - Keanu Reeves, Thomas Middleditch, Alice Eve, John Ortiz, Emjay Anthony (Science fiction, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Oscar Shaw
programme.desc: Haunted by the tragic loss of his closest friend, a retired detective embarks on a perilous quest for vengeance as he fights to restore justice to the streets he once protected. - Michael Jai White, Tyrese Gibson, Isaiah Washington, Cecile Cubilo, Vince Jolivette (Action)

programme.title: Things Never Said

programme.title: Wanderlust
programme.desc: George (Paul Rudd) and Linda (Jennifer Aniston) have overextended, overstressed lives in Manhattan.
